newsitem.title: USA: Wake Forest, N.C., proposes $15.6 mln in bonds.
newsitem.headline: Wake Forest, N.C., proposes $15.6 mln in bonds.

text.p: Commissoners in the North Carolina town of Wake Forest have proposed a $15.6 million general obligation bond issue for water, sewer and park projects.
The tentative proposal will be refined at the commission's Feb 18 meeting, and a referendum could be set for some time next year. The bond referendum would be the town's first in seven years.
Town Manager Mark Willisms said tax rates probably would not have to be increased, so long as property values increase at the projected rate of 15 percent.

The bond issue would raise $3.7 million to replace, relocate and upgrade the Richland Creek sewage pump station. The remainder would be used for parks and recreation projects and construction of a community center.
